Obstetric Drugs 2002 Obstetric Drug Groups, p.2002 Ergot alkaloids, p.2002 Oxytocics, p.2002 Prostaglandins, p.2002 Tocolytics, p.2002 Management of Obstetric Conditions, p.2002 Labour induction and augmentation, p.2002 Lactation inhibition and induction, p.2003 Postpartum haemorrhage, p.2003 Premature labour, p.2003 Termination of pregnancy, p.2004 This chapter includes a number of drugs used in obstet- rics for the management of labour and postpartum haemorrhage, including various prostaglandins, oxyto- cics, ergot alkaloids, and tocolytics. Some of these drugs have also been used to terminate pregnancy, as has the antiprogestogen mifepristone (p.2011). Other drugs with important roles in obstetric manage- ment to be found elsewhere in Martindale include local anaesthetics (p.1850), opioid analgesics (p.101), and medical gases such as oxygen (p.1690) and nitrous ox- ide (p.1789). For drugs used in the management of perinatal bacterial infection, see Antibacterials (p.158). Obstetric Drug Groups Ergot alkaloids Some ergot alkaloids have a powerful action on the uterus, causing uterine contractions that are utilised in the active management of the third stage of labour, and to prevent or treat postpartum and postabortal haemorrhage. Described in this chapter are Ergometrine, p.2009 Ergotoxine, p.2010 Ergot, p.2010 Methylergometrine, p.2011 Oxytocics Oxytocics cause contraction of the uterus and may be used for the induction and augmentation of labour, in the man- agement of the third stage of labour, and to prevent and treat postpartum haemorrhage. Described in this chapter are Carbetocin, p.2005 Oxytocin, p.2015 Demoxytocin, p.2006 Prostaglandins Some prostaglandins soften and dilate the cervix and in- duce contraction of the uterus. They may be used in labour induction, termination of pregnancy, and the treatment of postpartum haemorrhage. Described in this chapter are Carboprost, p.2006 Meteneprost, p.2010 Dinoprost, p.2006 Misoprostol, p.2013 Dinoprostone, p.2007 Sulprostone, p.2018 Gemeprost, p.2010 Tocolytics Tocolytics inhibit uterine contractions and are used in pre- mature labour to delay early delivery.
